public_rationale: Musk did forecast AI smarter than the smartest human around this timeframe, but Reuters records uncertainty and a possible 2026 date. Marcus's description as a promise is stronger than that record. ARC Prize explicitly judged AGI unachieved in December 2025, which supports Marcus's assessment. However, that judgement uses a particular conception of general intelligence, precedes further December progress, and does not settle Musk's unspecified comparison. The evidence supports continued capability gaps but does not establish the categorical claim that this forecast was proved false. [Reuters report](https://tech.yahoo.com/ai/articles/elon-musk-predicts-ai-smarter-174326728.html), [ARC assessment](https://arcprize.org/blog/arc-prize-2025-results-analysis), [December update](https://poetiq.ai/posts/update_arcagi_gpt52/).
limitations: An unresolved result does not establish that AGI existed in 2025.
Benchmark success or failure alone cannot settle the broad claim.
The ambiguity concerns both the deadline and the capability threshold.

statement.excerpt: Note that this list of Elon’s failed prediction is incomplete and omits for example Musk’s promises that we would achieve AGI by 2025, which proved to be false,
statement.document_title: Sorry, Sam and Elon, we have not reached the Singularity

our_interpretation: This assesses Marcus's retrospective claim, not a new forecast starting on the post date.
I read 'by 2025' generously as by December 31, 2025, and assess capabilities during that calendar year.

The ordinary reading of AGI in this context is broadly human-level or better cognitive capability, including learning and handling unfamiliar tasks. Success on one specialist benchmark does not establish it.
Marcus supplies no agreed test or threshold. Musk's original definition, timing qualifications and degree of confidence must therefore be checked before describing his prediction as a failed promise.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes that Musk forecast AGI by the end of 2025 and that AI systems available by that deadline still lacked the broad cognitive capabilities his forecast described.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence establishes that a system achieved the broad capability Musk described by the end of 2025, or that the prediction attributed to him materially misstates his actual forecast.
